example_1_en: I have a red apple in my schoolbag.
example_1_zh_tw: 我的書包裡有一個紅蘋果。
example_2_en: She cut the sweet apple into small pieces.
example_2_zh_tw: 她將那顆甜蘋果切成小塊。

example_1_en: The yellow banana is very sweet and delicious.
example_1_zh_tw: 黃色的香蕉非常甜而且美味。
example_2_en: I like to eat a banana after running.
example_2_zh_tw: 我喜歡在跑步後吃一根香蕉。

example_1_en: Look at that cute rabbit hopping in the grass.
example_1_zh_tw: 看那隻可愛的兔子在草地上蹦蹦跳跳。
example_2_en: The little rabbit likes eating fresh carrots.
example_2_zh_tw: 小兔子喜歡吃新鮮的胡蘿蔔。

example_1_en: The tiger is a very strong animal in the zoo.
example_1_zh_tw: 老虎是動物園裡非常強壯的動物。
example_2_en: A tiger can run very fast in the forest.
example_2_zh_tw: 老虎在森林裡能跑得非常快。

example_1_en: My father goes to work by bus every morning.
example_1_zh_tw: 我爸爸每天早上坐公車去上班。
example_2_en: My father reads a storybook to me every night.
example_2_zh_tw: 我爸爸每天晚上都讀故事書給我聽。

example_1_en: My mother cooks delicious food for the family.
example_1_zh_tw: 我媽媽為全家人做美味的食物。
example_2_en: My mother helps me with my homework after school.
example_2_zh_tw: 放學後我媽媽會輔導我的功課。

example_1_en: My sister likes to draw pictures in her notebook.
example_1_zh_tw: 我妹妹喜歡在筆記本上畫畫。
example_2_en: My sister teaches me how to ride a bicycle.
example_2_zh_tw: 我姊姊教我怎麼騎腳踏車。

example_1_en: My big brother teaches me how to play soccer.
example_1_zh_tw: 我哥哥教我怎麼踢足球。
example_2_en: My brother always shares his toys with me.
example_2_zh_tw: 我弟弟/哥哥總是跟我分享他的玩具。

example_1_en: We can go for a picnic on a sunny day.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們可以在晴天去野餐。
example_2_en: We go to play on the swings on a sunny day.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在晴天時去玩鞦韆。

example_1_en: I stay at home and read books on rainy days.
example_1_zh_tw: 下雨天我待在家裡看書。
example_2_en: Don't forget to wear a raincoat on rainy days.
example_2_zh_tw: 下雨天別忘了穿雨衣。

example_1_en: Our English teacher is very kind and patient.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們的英文老師非常親切且有檢心。
example_2_en: A teacher teaches students new things every day.
example_2_zh_tw: 老師每天教學生新的事物。

example_1_en: Every student in the class likes the new storybook.
example_1_zh_tw: 班上的每個學生都喜歡這本新的故事書。
example_2_en: Every student should try their best during class.
example_2_zh_tw: 每個學生在上課時都應該盡力而為。

example_1_en: You should wash your hands in the bathroom.
example_1_zh_tw: 你應該在浴室洗手。
example_2_en: Please wash your face and hands in the bathroom.
example_2_zh_tw: 請在浴室裡洗臉和洗手。

example_1_en: Mom is baking a delicious chocolate cake in the kitchen.
example_1_zh_tw: 媽媽正在廚房烤美味的巧克力蛋糕。
example_2_en: Dad is cleaning the kitchen table after dinner.
example_2_zh_tw: 晚餐後爸爸正在清理廚房的桌子。

example_1_en: The doctor tells me to drink more warm water.
example_1_zh_tw: 醫生叫我多喝溫開水。
example_2_en: A doctor helps people feel better when they are sick.
example_2_zh_tw: 當人們生病時，醫生會幫助他們好起來。

example_1_en: The kind nurse helps take care of sick children.
example_1_zh_tw: 這位親切的護理師幫忙照顧生病的孩子。
example_2_en: The school nurse cleaned the scratch on my knee.
example_2_zh_tw: 學校護理師幫我清理了膝蓋上的擦傷。

example_1_en: Remember to finish your English homework before dinner.
example_1_zh_tw: 記得在晚餐前完成你的英文作業。
example_2_en: I finished my homework and went to play with my puppy.
example_2_zh_tw: 我做完功課，然後去和小狗玩。

example_1_en: We bought some fresh juice at the supermarket.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們在超市買了一些新鮮果汁。
example_2_en: My mother bought some fresh apples at the supermarket.
example_2_zh_tw: 我媽媽在超級市場買了一些新鮮的蘋果。

example_1_en: The sunset over the beach is really beautiful.
example_1_zh_tw: 海灘上的落日真的很美麗。
example_2_en: The flowers in our school garden are very beautiful.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們學校花園裡的花非常美麗。

example_1_en: What are you going to do this weekend?
example_1_zh_tw: 你這週末打算做什麼？
example_2_en: We visited our grandparents on the weekend.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在週末去拜訪了祖父母。

example_1_en: I like reading this interesting book about animals.
example_1_zh_tw: 我喜歡讀這本關於動物的有趣書籍。
example_2_en: I borrowed an interesting story book from the library.
example_2_zh_tw: 我從圖書館借了一本有趣的故事書。

example_1_en: Can I borrow a pencil to write my name?
example_1_zh_tw: 我可以借一支鉛筆來寫我的名字嗎？
example_2_en: May I borrow your pencil to draw a star?
example_2_zh_tw: 我可以借你的鉛筆畫一顆星星嗎？

example_1_en: Please put your books back onto your desk.
example_1_zh_tw: 請把你的書放回你的課桌上。
example_2_en: He keeps his books organized on his study desk.
example_2_zh_tw: 他在書桌上把書整理得很整齊。

example_1_en: Tim sits on the wooden chair next to the window.
example_1_zh_tw: 提姆坐在靠窗的木椅上。
example_2_en: The cat sat on the chair and slept all afternoon.
example_2_zh_tw: 貓咪坐在椅子上睡了整個下午。

example_1_en: The friendly dog is wagging its tail at us.
example_1_zh_tw: 那隻友好的狗正在向我們搖尾巴。
example_2_en: My friendly dog runs to me when I come home.
example_2_zh_tw: 當我回到家時，我那友善的狗會跑向我。

example_1_en: A small black cat is sleeping under the table.
example_1_zh_tw: 一隻黑色的小貓正在桌子底下睡覺。
example_2_en: The sleeping cat looks very warm and cute.
example_2_zh_tw: 那隻正在睡覺的貓咪看起來非常溫暖且可愛。

example_1_en: A beautiful blue bird is singing in the tree.
example_1_zh_tw: 一隻美麗的藍鳥正在樹上唱歌。
example_2_en: We can hear a little bird singing outside the window.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們可以聽到窗外有一隻小鳥在唱歌。

example_1_en: There are many colorful fish swimming in the pond.
example_1_zh_tw: 池塘裡有許多色彩繽紛的魚在游泳。
example_2_en: My grandpa has three gold fish in a bowl.
example_2_zh_tw: 我爺爺在魚缸裡養了三隻金魚。

example_1_en: Drinking a glass of hot milk before bed helps you sleep.
example_1_zh_tw: 睡前喝一杯熱牛奶有助於睡眠。
example_2_en: Drinking milk every day helps our bones grow strong.
example_2_zh_tw: 每天喝牛奶可以幫助我們的骨骼長得強壯。

example_1_en: Please give me a glass of cold water, please.
example_1_zh_tw: 請給我一杯冰水，謝謝。
example_2_en: You should drink a cup of warm water every morning.
example_2_zh_tw: 你應該每天早上喝一杯溫開水。

example_1_en: We usually eat rice and vegetables for dinner.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們晚餐通常吃米飯和蔬菜。
example_2_en: We eat rice and fish for lunch at school.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在學校午餐吃米飯和魚。

example_1_en: Grandpa likes to eat hot beef noodles for lunch.
example_1_zh_tw: 爺爺中午喜歡吃熱牛肉麵。
example_2_en: My sister likes to eat delicious noodles with soup.
example_2_zh_tw: 我妹妹喜歡吃美味的湯麵。

example_1_en: She wore a pretty red dress to the party.
example_1_zh_tw: 她穿著一件漂亮的紅洋裝去參加派對。
example_2_en: The red crayon in my box is used to draw the sun.
example_2_zh_tw: 我盒子裡的紅蠟筆是用來畫太陽的。

example_1_en: The sky is very clear and blue today.
example_1_zh_tw: 今天的晴空非常清澈且蔚藍。
example_2_en: I draw a blue bird flying high in the sky.
example_2_zh_tw: 我畫了一隻在空中高飛的藍鳥。

example_1_en: The frogs are sitting on a big green leaf.
example_1_zh_tw: 青蛙正坐在一個綠色的大葉子上。
example_2_en: The tree leaves are green and fresh in spring.
example_2_zh_tw: 春天的樹葉又綠又新鮮。

example_1_en: The yellow school bus stops in front of my house.
example_1_zh_tw: 黃色的校車停在我家前面。
example_2_en: My brother's favorite color is bright yellow.
example_2_zh_tw: 我弟弟最喜歡的顏色是明亮的黃色。

example_1_en: I have only one apple left in my bag.
example_1_zh_tw: 我的包包裡只剩下一個蘋果。
example_2_en: I got one correct answer and felt very happy.
example_2_zh_tw: 我得到一個正確答案，感覺非常高興。

example_1_en: There are two birds flying in the sky.
example_1_zh_tw: 天上有兩隻鳥在飛。
example_2_en: Two students walked into the library together.
example_2_zh_tw: 兩個學生一起走進了圖書館。

example_1_en: He has three storybooks in his desk drawer.
example_1_zh_tw: 他的書桌抽屜裡有三本故事書。
example_2_en: Grandfather bought three sweet red apples for us.
example_2_zh_tw: 爺爺為我們買了三個甜紅蘋果。

example_1_en: A year is divided into four different seasons.
example_1_zh_tw: 一年被分為四個不同的季節。
example_2_en: Four birds are sitting on the school roof.
example_2_zh_tw: 四隻鳥停在學校屋頂上。

example_1_en: You should wear a helmet to protect your head.
example_1_zh_tw: 你應該戴安全帽來保護你的頭部。
example_2_en: Please wear a hat to protect your head from the hot sun.
example_2_zh_tw: 請戴上帽子以保護你的頭部不受烈日曬傷。

example_1_en: Please raise your hand if you know the answer.
example_1_zh_tw: 如果你知道答案，請舉手。
example_2_en: We must wash our hands before having lunch.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們午餐前必須洗手。

example_1_en: Keep your eyes open and look at the screen.
example_1_zh_tw: 張開眼睛看著螢幕。
example_2_en: Please close your eyes and listen to the quiet music.
example_2_zh_tw: 請閉上眼睛，聆聽這平靜的音樂。

example_1_en: He hurt his left foot while playing soccer.
example_1_zh_tw: 他在踢足球時弄傷了左腳。
example_2_en: My foot feels cold, so I want to wear socks.
example_2_zh_tw: 我的腳感覺冷，所以我想穿襪子。

example_1_en: Do not run in the hallway; it is dangerous.
example_1_zh_tw: 不要在走廊上奔跑，那很危險。
example_2_en: Do not run too fast in the classroom.
example_2_zh_tw: 不要在教室裡跑得太快。

example_1_en: The energetic children love to jump on the trampoline.
example_1_zh_tw: 精力充沛的孩子們喜歡在彈簧床上跳躍。
example_2_en: The frog can jump very high into the air.
example_2_zh_tw: 青蛙可以跳得非常高。

example_1_en: We read English stories in class every Tuesday.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們每個星期二在課堂上讀英文故事。
example_2_en: Reading books every day makes us smarter.
example_2_zh_tw: 每天讀書會讓我們更聰明。

example_1_en: You need to write your name on this paper.
example_1_zh_tw: 你需要這張紙上寫下你的名字。
example_2_en: Please write down your name on the notebook.
example_2_zh_tw: 請在筆記本上寫下你的名字。

example_1_en: We say good morning to our teachers at school.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們在學校跟老師們說早安。
example_2_en: I enjoy the fresh air during my morning run.
example_2_zh_tw: 我享受晨跑時的新鮮空氣。

example_1_en: Let us play basketball in the playground this afternoon.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們今天下午去操場打籃球吧。
example_2_en: We have an exciting art lesson this afternoon.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們今天下午有一堂精彩的美勞課。

example_1_en: What is the weather like in Taipei today?
example_1_zh_tw: 今天台北的天氣怎麼樣？
example_2_en: Today is a great day to learn new English words.
example_2_zh_tw: 今天是學習新英文單字的好日子。

example_1_en: We are very happy to hear the good news.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們聽到這個好消息感到非常高興。
example_2_en: My parents are happy when I share my stories with them.
example_2_zh_tw: 當我和父母分享我的故事時，他們會很高興。

example_1_en: This math question is too difficult for me to solve.
example_1_zh_tw: 這道數學題對我來說太難解了。
example_2_en: Even if this game is difficult, I will keep trying.
example_2_zh_tw: 即使這個遊戲很難，我依然會繼續嘗試。

example_1_en: A busy bee is flying around the colorful flowers.
example_1_zh_tw: 一隻忙碌的蜜蜂正在繽紛的花朵旁飛舞。
example_2_en: The little bee works hard to make honey.
example_2_zh_tw: 小蜜蜂辛勤地工作製造蜂蜜。

example_1_en: The cow eats green grass on the beautiful farm.
example_1_zh_tw: 母牛在美麗的農場上吃綠草。
example_2_en: The cow on the farm gives us fresh milk.
example_2_zh_tw: 農場上的乳牛為我們提供新鮮牛奶。

example_1_en: A rabbit can be a wonderful pet for children.
example_1_zh_tw: 兔子可以是孩子們極佳的寵物。
example_2_en: My pet cat likes to sleep on my lap.
example_2_zh_tw: 我的寵物貓喜歡在我的大腿上睡覺。

example_1_en: The pink pig is playing happily in the mud.
example_1_zh_tw: 這隻粉紅色的豬正在泥巴裡玩得很高興。
example_2_en: The cute pig lives with other animals on the farm.
example_2_zh_tw: 那隻可愛的豬和農場上的其他動物生活在一起。

example_1_en: We saw a big brown bear sleeping in the cave.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們看到一隻大棕熊在洞穴裡睡覺。
example_2_en: A bear eats fish and berries in the forest.
example_2_zh_tw: 熊在森林裡吃魚和莓果。

example_1_en: The little duck swims behind its mother in the pond.
example_1_zh_tw: 小鴨在池塘裡跟在牠媽媽後面游泳。
example_2_en: The white duck made a funny sound in the water.
example_2_zh_tw: 白鴨在水裡發出了有趣的聲音。

example_1_en: A green frog jumped out of the clean water.
example_1_zh_tw: 一隻綠色的青蛙從乾淨的水中跳了出來。
example_2_en: A green frog is sitting peacefully on a wet stone.
example_2_zh_tw: 一隻綠色青蛙正安靜地坐在濕石頭上。

example_1_en: The lion is known as the king of the forest.
example_1_zh_tw: 獅子被稱為森林之王。
example_2_en: We saw a big lion walking slowly in the zoo.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們看到一隻大獅子在動物園裡慢慢走動。

example_1_en: Our cat caught three small mice last night.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們的小貓昨晚抓到了三隻小老鼠。
example_2_en: The mice ran away quickly when they saw the big cat.
example_2_zh_tw: 老鼠們看到大貓時飛快地逃跑了。

example_1_en: The hippo stays in the water to keep cool.
example_1_zh_tw: 河馬待在水裡以保持涼爽。
example_2_en: The hippo opened its huge mouth to eat fruit.
example_2_zh_tw: 河馬張開牠的大嘴巴吃水果。

example_1_en: The cowboy rode a fast black horse yesterday.
example_1_zh_tw: 牛仔昨天騎著一隻跑得很快的黑馬。
example_2_en: The horse ran across the green field very quickly.
example_2_zh_tw: 那匹馬非常快速地跑過綠色草地。

example_1_en: A cute koala is hugging the eucalyptus tree.
example_1_zh_tw: 一隻可愛的無尾熊正抱著尤加利樹。
example_2_en: We watched the koala eating eucalyptus leaves in the tree.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們看著無尾熊在樹上吃尤加利樹葉。

example_1_en: The clever little mouse escaped from the cat.
example_1_zh_tw: 聰明的小老鼠從貓咪手裡逃脫了。
example_2_en: A tiny mouse is eating a piece of cheese quietly.
example_2_zh_tw: 一隻小老鼠正在安靜地吃一片起司。

example_1_en: The giant panda is eating fresh bamboo leaves.
example_1_zh_tw: 大貓熊正在吃新鮮的竹葉。
example_2_en: The baby panda is playing with a small wood block.
example_2_zh_tw: 熊貓寶寶正在玩一塊小木頭。

example_1_en: A group of white sheep are grazing on the hill.
example_1_zh_tw: 一群白羊正在山丘上吃草。
example_2_en: The farmer shears the wool from the sheep in summer.
example_2_zh_tw: 農夫在夏天剪掉綿羊身上的羊毛。

example_1_en: Be careful! There is a long snake in the grass.
example_1_zh_tw: 小心！草叢裡有一條長蛇。
example_2_en: A green snake is climbing up a tall tree.
example_2_zh_tw: 一條綠蛇正往高樹上爬。

example_1_en: The blue whale is the largest animal in the ocean.
example_1_zh_tw: 藍鯨是海洋中最大的動物。
example_2_en: The huge whale made a big splash in the ocean.
example_2_zh_tw: 巨大的鯨魚在海洋中激起了大水花。

example_1_en: The zebra has beautiful black and white stripes.
example_1_zh_tw: 斑馬有美麗的黑白條紋。
example_2_en: We took a picture of a beautiful zebra yesterday.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們昨天拍了一隻美麗斑馬的照片。

example_1_en: We should protect wild animals and their forests.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們應該保護野生動物和牠們的森林。
example_2_en: A dog is a very helpful animal to humans.
example_2_zh_tw: 狗是對人類非常有幫助的動物。

example_1_en: The funny monkey is climbing the tall banana tree.
example_1_zh_tw: 這隻有趣的猴子正在爬高高的香蕉樹。
example_2_en: The clever monkey is playing with a round orange.
example_2_zh_tw: 聰明的猴子正在玩一顆圓圓的橘子。

example_1_en: A spider is spinning a web in the corner.
example_1_zh_tw: 一隻蜘蛛正角落裡織網。
example_2_en: A little spider is making its web on the wall.
example_2_zh_tw: 一隻小蜘蛛正在牆上織網。

example_1_en: The turtle walks very slowly but can swim fast.
example_1_zh_tw: 烏龜爬得很慢但是游得很快。
example_2_en: The small turtle rests on a rock in the park pond.
example_2_zh_tw: 小烏龜在公園池塘的岩石上休息。

example_1_en: The farmer feeds the hungry chickens every morning.
example_1_zh_tw: 農夫每天早上餵飢餓的雞。
example_2_en: The hen walks with three baby chickens in the yard.
example_2_zh_tw: 母雞帶著三隻小雞在院子裡走動。

example_1_en: The giant elephant is spraying water with its long nose.
example_1_zh_tw: 大象正用牠的長鼻子噴水。
example_2_en: The elephant uses its long trunk to pick up leaves.
example_2_zh_tw: 大象用牠的長鼻子來撿樹葉。

example_1_en: A beautiful butterfly is sitting on the yellow flower.
example_1_zh_tw: 一隻美麗的蝴蝶停在黃花上。
example_2_en: A beautiful butterfly landed on my sister's shoulder.
example_2_zh_tw: 一隻美麗的蝴蝶落在她姊姊/妹妹的肩膀上。

example_1_en: Put your pencil box and textbooks into your bag.
example_1_zh_tw: 把你的鉛筆盒和教科書放進包包裡。
example_2_en: She packed her lunchbox inside her school bag.

example_2_en: I always feel thirsty after running on the playground.

example_2_en: This hot noodle soup is really yummy and warm.
example_2_zh_tw: 這碗熱麵湯真的很美味又溫暖。

example_1_zh_tw: 我們在萬聖節南瓜上雕刻了一個有趣的臉。
example_2_en: My grandmother makes sweet pumpkin pie for dessert.
example_2_zh_tw: 我祖母做甜南瓜派當甜點。

example_1_en: Children love to eat sweet vanilla ice cream in summer.
example_1_zh_tw: 孩子們夏天喜歡吃甜香草冰淇淋。
example_2_en: Vanilla ice cream is my brother's favorite treat.
example_2_zh_tw: 香草冰淇淋是我弟弟最喜歡的甜點。

example_1_en: These ripe strawberries are very red and sweet.
example_1_zh_tw: 這些熟透的草莓又紅又甜。
example_2_en: She made a sweet card to thank her kind teacher.
example_2_zh_tw: 她做了一張貼心的卡片來感謝她親切的老師。

example_1_zh_tw: 我為我的午餐做了一個火腿起司三明治。
example_2_en: My mother packed a fresh sandwich in my lunchbox.
example_2_zh_tw: 我媽媽在我的便當盒裡裝了一個新鮮三明治。

example_1_zh_tw: 她買了一盒比利時黑巧克力。
example_2_en: We share a chocolate bar after playing basketball.
example_2_zh_tw: 打完籃球後我們一起分享一條巧克力棒。

example_1_en: He ordered a beef hamburger and some french fries.
example_1_zh_tw: 他點了一個牛肉漢堡和一些薯條。
example_2_en: A giant hamburger with fresh lettuce tastes delicious.
example_2_zh_tw: 夾著新鮮萵苣的巨無霸漢堡嚐起來很美味。

example_1_en: We ordered some hot french fries at the fast-food shop.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們在速食店點了一些熱薯條。
example_2_en: Our new classmate can speak both English and French.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們的新同學會說英文和法文。

example_1_en: The crispy fries taste great with tomato sauce.
example_1_zh_tw: 脆脆的薯條搭配番茄醬味道很棒。
example_2_en: Hot potato fries are crispy and delicious to share.
example_2_zh_tw: 熱騰騰的炸薯條香脆美味，適合一起分享。

example_1_en: Please write down your name and phone number here.
example_1_zh_tw: 請在這裡寫下您的名字和電話號碼。
example_2_en: I wrote my name on the first page of the book.
example_2_zh_tw: 我在書的第一頁寫下了我的名字。

example_1_en: Ms. Lin is our new school principal this year.
example_1_zh_tw: 林女士是我們今年新來的學校校長。
example_2_en: Miss Lin is very patient when she teaches us math.
example_2_zh_tw: 林老師教我們數學時非常耐心。

example_1_en: Mr. Brown teaches us math and is very funny.
example_1_zh_tw: 布朗先生教我們數學而且非常幽默。
example_2_en: Mr. Wang helps us clean the school playground every Friday.
example_2_zh_tw: 王先生每個星期五都幫我們清理學校操場。

example_1_en: Mrs. Green gave us some sweet cookies yesterday.
example_1_zh_tw: 格林太太昨天給了我們一些甜餅乾。
example_2_en: Mrs. Lee teaches science and always answers our questions.
example_2_zh_tw: 李太太教自然科學，而且總是回答我們的問題。

example_1_en: We saw a big ship sailing on the blue sea.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們看到一隻大船在藍色的大海上航行。
example_2_en: We can collect pretty shells on the beach near the sea.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們可以在靠海的沙灘上收集美麗的貝殼。

example_1_en: The water in the lake is clear and calm.
example_1_zh_tw: 湖水非常清澈而且平靜。
example_2_en: We rode a boat on the lake during our family trip.
example_2_zh_tw: 在我們的家庭旅行中，我們在湖上划船。

example_1_en: We built a tall sandcastle on the sandy beach.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們在沙灘上建了一座高高的沙堡。
example_2_en: We built a big sandcastle on the beach in the afternoon.
example_2_zh_tw: 下午我們在海灘上建了一座大沙堡。

example_1_en: Many fish are swimming in this clean mountain river.
example_1_zh_tw: 許多魚在這條乾淨的山區河流中游泳。
example_2_en: The clean river flows slowly through our beautiful town.
example_2_zh_tw: 乾淨的河流緩緩流過我們美麗的小鎮。

example_1_en: They plan to climb the highest mountain in Taiwan.
example_1_zh_tw: 他們計劃攀登台灣最高的山。
example_2_en: We went hiking on a high mountain last weekend.
example_2_zh_tw: 上週末我們去了一座高山健行。

example_1_en: There are many tall green trees in the forest.
example_1_zh_tw: 森林裡有許多高大的綠樹。
example_2_en: Many wild animals make their homes in the deep forest.
example_2_zh_tw: 許多野生動物在深山森林裡安家。

example_1_en: The volcano has not erupted for a thousand years.
example_1_zh_tw: 這座火山已經一千年沒有噴發了。
example_2_en: We saw a picture of an active volcano in our science book.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在自然科學書裡看到了一張活火山的照片。

example_1_en: Camels can walk in the hot desert without water.
example_1_zh_tw: 駱駝可以在炎熱的沙漠中行走而不需要水。
example_2_en: It is dry and hot in the desert, but camels can live there.
example_2_zh_tw: 沙漠裡又乾又熱，但是駱駝可以在那裡生存。

example_1_en: They spent their summer vacation on a tropical island.
example_1_zh_tw: 他們在一個熱帶島嶼上度過了暑假。
example_2_en: Taiwan is a beautiful island surrounded by blue oceans.
example_2_zh_tw: 台灣是一個被藍色海洋包圍的美麗島嶼。

example_1_en: Children love to search for colorful Easter eggs.
example_1_zh_tw: 孩子們喜歡尋找色彩繽紛的復活節彩蛋。
example_2_en: Children search for colorful eggs during Easter.
example_2_zh_tw: 孩子們在復活節期間尋找彩色的蛋。

example_1_en: We dressed up in scary clothes for Halloween.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們在萬聖節穿上了可怕的衣服裝扮。
example_2_en: We dressed up as funny ghosts for Halloween last year.
example_2_zh_tw: 去年萬聖節我們裝扮成搞笑的鬼魂。

example_1_en: We decorated the big Christmas tree with sparkling lights.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們用閃閃發光的燈飾裝飾了大聖誕樹。
example_2_en: We decorated the classroom tree for Christmas.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們裝飾了教室裡的聖誕樹來迎接耶誕節。

example_1_en: The moon shines brightly in the clear night sky.
example_1_zh_tw: 月亮在晴朗的夜空中明亮地照耀著。
example_2_en: The moon is round and bright during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
example_2_zh_tw: 中秋節期間的月亮又圓又亮。

example_1_en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for family reunion.
example_1_zh_tw: 中秋節是家人團圓的時刻。
example_2_en: The school sports festival is full of exciting games.
example_2_zh_tw: 學校運動會/體育節充滿了精彩的比賽。

example_1_en: My grandmother feels well after resting in bed.
example_1_zh_tw: 我奶奶在床上休息後感覺好多了。
example_2_en: My brother plays the piano very well because he practices.
example_2_zh_tw: 我弟弟鋼琴彈得很好，因為他有練習。

example_1_en: He did not go to school because he was sick.
example_1_zh_tw: 他因為生病而沒有去上學。
example_2_en: If you feel sick, you should rest and drink warm water.
example_2_zh_tw: 如果你感覺生病了，你應該休息並喝溫開水。

example_1_en: Drink hot soup when you have a bad cold.
example_1_zh_tw: 當你感冒嚴重時，多喝熱湯。
example_2_en: Drinking hot tea makes us feel good when we have a cold.
example_2_zh_tw: 感冒時喝熱茶會讓我們感覺舒服些。

example_1_en: He is strong enough to lift the heavy box.
example_1_zh_tw: 他足夠強壯以搬起這個重箱子。
example_2_en: A strong wind can bend the branches of tall trees.
example_2_zh_tw: 強風會吹彎高樹的枝條。

example_1_en: I was tired after riding my bike for two hours.
example_1_zh_tw: 騎了兩小時腳踏車後，我感到很累。
example_2_en: I felt tired after running around the playground.
example_2_zh_tw: 在操場跑了幾圈後我感到累了。

example_1_en: The little girl cried because she had a toothache.
example_1_zh_tw: 小女孩哭了，因為她牙痛。
example_2_en: Eating too much sweet candy might cause a toothache.
example_2_zh_tw: 吃太多甜糖果可能會導致牙痛。

example_1_en: My mother has a bad headache today.
example_1_zh_tw: 我媽媽今天頭痛得很厲害。
example_2_en: Drinking cold water too quickly might give you a headache.
example_2_zh_tw: 冰水喝太快可能會讓你頭痛。

example_1_en: I cannot find the key to my bedroom door.
example_1_zh_tw: 我找不到我臥室門的鑰匙。
example_2_en: He keeps the classroom key in his pencil case.
example_2_zh_tw: 他把教室的鑰匙收在筆袋裡。

example_1_en: Please turn on the fan, the classroom is hot.
example_1_zh_tw: 請打開電風扇，教室很熱。
example_2_en: Please turn on the electric fan to cool down the room.
example_2_zh_tw: 請打開電風扇讓房間涼快一下。

example_1_en: It is time to go to bed; goodnight, children.
example_1_zh_tw: 該去睡覺了；晚安，孩子們。
example_2_en: I jumped onto my soft bed and felt very relaxed.
example_2_zh_tw: 我跳上柔軟的床，感到非常放鬆。

example_1_en: They live in a beautiful house with a garden.
example_1_zh_tw: 他們住在一棟帶花園的美麗房子裡。
example_2_en: My family lives in a cozy house near the school.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們家住在學校附近的一間溫馨房子裡。

example_1_en: We hung a big map of Taiwan on the classroom wall.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們在教室的牆上掛了一幅台灣大地圖。
example_2_en: We hung our class paintings on the classroom wall.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們把我們班的畫掛在教室牆壁上。

example_1_en: Use the clean mop to clean the kitchen floor.
example_1_zh_tw: 用乾淨的拖把來清潔廚房地板。
example_2_en: Please use a mop to clean the dirty floor.
example_2_zh_tw: 請用拖把清理骯髒的地板。

example_1_en: Please close the door behind you when you leave.
example_1_zh_tw: 你離開時請隨手關門。
example_2_en: Please close the door quietly when you leave.
example_2_zh_tw: 你離開時請輕輕關上門。

example_1_en: He reads a book under the bright desk lamp.
example_1_zh_tw: 他在明亮的檯燈下看書。
example_2_en: I turn on the desk lamp when I read at night.
example_2_zh_tw: 我晚上讀書時會打開檯燈。

example_1_en: Please help me sweep the leaves on the ground.
example_1_zh_tw: 請幫我掃地上的樹葉。
example_2_en: We sweep the classroom floor together after school.
example_2_zh_tw: 放學後我們一起打掃教室地板。

example_1_en: You should wash your hands before eating dinner.
example_1_zh_tw: 你在吃晚餐前應該要洗手。
example_2_en: We wash our hands before eating lunch at school.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在學校吃午餐前會洗手。

example_1_en: I will stay at home and watch TV tonight.
example_1_zh_tw: 我今天晚上會待在家裡看電視。
example_2_en: Going home to eat dinner with family is very warm.
example_2_zh_tw: 回家和家人一起吃晚餐是非常溫馨的。

example_1_en: We put the vase of flowers on the wooden table.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們把花瓶放在木桌上。
example_2_en: Please help set the dining table before dinner.
example_2_zh_tw: 請在晚餐前幫忙擺餐桌。

example_1_en: Dry your face with a clean and soft towel.
example_1_zh_tw: 用乾淨又柔軟的毛巾擦乾你的臉。
example_2_en: Dry your wet face with a clean soft towel.
example_2_zh_tw: 用乾淨柔軟的毛巾擦乾你那濕漉漉的臉。

example_1_en: The clean floor is too slippery; walk carefully.
example_1_zh_tw: 乾淨的地板太滑了，走路請小心。
example_2_en: Keep your books off the floor and on your desk.
example_2_zh_tw: 把你的書從地板上拿起來放在書桌上。

example_1_en: I put my new books back onto the bookshelf.
example_1_zh_tw: 我把我的新書放回書架上。
example_2_en: Please put the storybook back on the wooden shelf.
example_2_zh_tw: 請把故事書放回木架/書架上。

example_1_en: Grandpa grows sweet red strawberries in his garden.
example_1_zh_tw: 爺爺在他的花園裡種植甜甜的紅草莓。
example_2_en: The school garden has many colorful flowers.
example_2_zh_tw: 學校花園裡有許多色彩繽紛的花朵。

example_1_en: I take a warm shower after playing basketball.
example_1_zh_tw: 我打完籃球後會洗個熱水澡。
example_2_en: A quick summer shower cooled down the hot streets.
example_2_zh_tw: 一場短暫的夏日陣雨讓發熱的街道降溫了。

example_1_en: We watched an interesting science show on TV.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們在電視上觀看了一個有趣的科學節目。
example_2_en: Our parents allow us to watch TV for thirty minutes.
example_2_zh_tw: 我父母允許我們看三十分鐘的電視。

example_1_en: We use the computer to look up English words.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們使用電腦來查詢英文單字。
example_2_en: We learn how to type on the computer in class.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在課堂上學習如何在電腦上打字。

example_1_en: Keep the fresh milk and cheese in the refrigerator.
example_1_zh_tw: 把新鮮牛奶和起司保存在冰箱裡。
example_2_en: Put the fresh milk back in the refrigerator to keep it cool.
example_2_zh_tw: 把鮮牛奶放回冰箱以保持冰涼。

example_1_en: Please help me clean the dirty windows this afternoon.
example_1_zh_tw: 今天下午請幫我清潔髒窗戶。
example_2_en: We must clean our study desks before we go home.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們回家前必須打掃乾淨我們的書桌。

example_1_en: My bedroom has a small desk and a warm bed.
example_1_zh_tw: 我的臥室有一張小書桌和一張溫暖的床。
example_2_en: I sleep peacefully in my quiet bedroom.
example_2_zh_tw: 我在安靜的臥室裡安穩地睡覺。

example_1_en: The family had dinner together in the dining room.
example_1_zh_tw: 全家人在餐廳一起吃晚餐。
example_2_en: We gathered in the dining area to share the food.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在用餐區聚集分享食物。

example_1_en: Our living room is very bright and cozy.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們的客廳非常明亮而且溫馨。
example_2_en: My room has a soft bed and a tidy bookshelf.
example_2_zh_tw: 我的房間有一張柔軟的床和整齊的書架。

example_1_en: I want to buy a new box of crayons.
example_1_zh_tw: 我想買一盒新的蠟筆。
example_2_en: I want to buy a new pencil case at the shop.
example_2_zh_tw: 我想在商店買一個新的筆袋。

example_1_en: Children under six can enter the zoo for free.
example_1_zh_tw: 六歲以下的孩子可以免費進入動物園。
example_2_en: You are free to join our English game club.
example_2_zh_tw: 你可以自由加入我們的英文遊戲社團。

example_1_en: She saved some money to buy a storybook.
example_1_zh_tw: 她存了一些錢來買一本故事書。
example_2_en: Saving money helps us buy things we really need later.
example_2_zh_tw: 存錢可以幫助我們在以後購買真正需要的東西。

example_1_en: A cup of bubble tea costs fifty New Taiwan dollars.
example_1_zh_tw: 一杯珍珠奶茶要五十元新台幣。
example_2_en: A cup of hot tea costs one dollar at the stand.
example_2_zh_tw: 那攤位的一杯熱茶花費一元。

example_1_en: He has a new blue schoolbag for the school year.
example_1_zh_tw: 他新學年有一個新的藍色書包。
example_2_en: Welcome our new classmate with a warm hello.
example_2_zh_tw: 用溫馨的問候歡迎我們的新同學。

example_1_en: Seven is my sister's favorite and lucky number.
example_1_zh_tw: 七是我妹妹最喜歡且幸運的數字。
example_2_en: Please write the number of students in the blank.
example_2_zh_tw: 請在空格內寫上學生的數量。

example_1_zh_tw: 教室裡的學生們全都非常安靜。

example_2_zh_tw: 今天所有學生在測驗中都表現得很好。

example_1_en: Both of my brothers like to play basketball.
example_1_zh_tw: 我的兩個哥哥都喜歡打籃球。

example_2_zh_tw: 我的兩隻狗都很喜歡玩這顆球。

example_1_zh_tw: 我希望在假期期間讀更多的書。
example_2_en: Reading more books can help you learn new words.
example_2_zh_tw: 多讀書可以幫助你學習新單字。

example_1_zh_tw: 我媽媽為我們準備了一些新鮮水果。

example_2_zh_tw: 請給我一些紙寫字好嗎？

example_1_zh_tw: 他在英語演講比賽中贏得了一等獎。
example_2_en: Safety first is our number one rule when hiking.
example_2_zh_tw: 健行時，安全第一是我們的首要規則。

example_1_en: This is the second time I visit this beautiful museum.
example_1_zh_tw: 這是我第二次造訪這座美麗的博物館。
example_2_en: February is the second month of the year.
example_2_zh_tw: 二月是一年中的第二個月份。

example_1_en: Her classroom is on the third floor of the school.
example_1_zh_tw: 她的教室在學校的三樓。
example_2_en: He got the third place in the running race.
example_2_zh_tw: 他在跑步比賽中得到了第三名。

example_1_zh_tw: 十二月是一年中的最後一個月。

example_2_zh_tw: 這是我們每日挑戰的最後一個問題。

example_1_en: A teacher's job is to help students learn.

example_1_en: We usually do our homework in the early evening.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們通常在傍晚做功課。
example_2_en: We gather in the living room to talk in the evening.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們晚上在客廳聚集聊天。

example_1_en: The stars shine brightly in the dark sky at night.
example_1_zh_tw: 夜裡星星在黑暗的天空中明亮地照耀著。
example_2_en: The moon shines brightly in the dark night sky.
example_2_zh_tw: 月亮在黑夜的天空中明亮地照耀著。

example_1_en: Please come into the classroom and sit down now.
example_1_zh_tw: 現在請進教室坐好。
example_2_en: It is time to go to school now.
example_2_zh_tw: 現在是去學校的時候了。

example_1_en: Tomorrow is Sunday, so we do not go to school.
example_1_zh_tw: 明天是星期天，所以我們不上學。
example_2_en: We will have a science experiment tomorrow morning.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們明天早上有一堂自然科學實驗課。

example_1_en: We went to the beach on a warm sunny day.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們在一個溫暖的晴天去了海灘。
example_2_en: I hope you have a happy and wonderful day today.
example_2_zh_tw: 我希望你今天度過快樂又美好的一天。

example_1_en: I finished reading the whole book yesterday afternoon.
example_1_zh_tw: 我昨天下午讀完了整本書。
example_2_en: We played basketball in the park yesterday afternoon.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們昨天下午在公園打了籃球。

example_1_en: The diligent student always arrives at school very early.
example_1_zh_tw: 勤奮的學生總是早早就到學校。
example_2_en: I wake up early in the morning to see the sunrise.
example_2_zh_tw: 我清晨早起看日出。

example_1_en: Hurry up! We are going to be late for class.
example_1_zh_tw: 快一點！我們上課要遲到了。
example_2_en: Please hurry up so we won't be late for the schoolbus.
example_2_zh_tw: 請快一點，這樣我們搭校車才不會遲到。

example_1_en: What time does the school library open on weekdays?
example_1_zh_tw: 學校圖書館在工作日幾點開放？
example_2_en: It is time to go to bed now. Good night!
example_2_zh_tw: 現在是睡覺時間了。晚安！

example_1_en: My dad bought me a nice watch for my birthday.
example_1_zh_tw: 我爸爸買了一隻漂亮的手錶送我當生日禮物。
example_2_en: My grandfather gave me a nice digital watch as a gift.
example_2_zh_tw: 我爺爺送我一隻精美的手錶當作禮物。

example_1_en: We are looking forward to a wonderful new year.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們正期待著美好的一年。
example_2_en: This school year is going to be full of fun learning.
example_2_zh_tw: 這個學年將會充滿有趣的學習。

example_1_en: The clock on the wall shows it is eight o'clock.
example_1_zh_tw: 牆上的時鐘顯示現在是八點鐘。
example_2_en: The clock on the wall shows that it is eight o'clock.
example_2_zh_tw: 牆上的時鐘顯示現在是八點鐘。

example_1_en: The school sports day starts at nine o'clock sharp.
example_1_zh_tw: 學校運動會在九點整準時開始。
example_2_en: We have an English lesson at nine o'clock today.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們今天九點鐘有一堂英文課。

example_1_en: Many beautiful flowers bloom in the warm spring.
example_1_zh_tw: 許多美麗的花朵在溫暖的春天盛開。
example_2_en: Beautiful flowers start to open in warm spring.
example_2_zh_tw: 美麗的花朵在溫暖的春天開始綻放。

example_1_en: We love to eat cold watermelon in the hot summer.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們在炎熱的夏天熱愛吃冰西瓜。
example_2_en: Summer is hot, and we love to eat cold ice cream.
example_2_zh_tw: 夏天很熱，我們很喜歡吃冰涼的冰淇淋。

example_1_en: Leaves turn yellow and fall from trees in autumn.
example_1_zh_tw: 秋天時葉子變黃並從樹上落下。
example_2_en: Watch your step so you do not fall on the wet grass.
example_2_zh_tw: 看好你的腳步，才不會在濕草地上跌倒。

example_1_en: It is very cold and sometimes snows in winter.
example_1_zh_tw: 冬天非常冷，有時候還會下雪。
example_2_en: It gets very cold in winter, so we wear warm coats.
example_2_zh_tw: 冬天的天氣變得很冷，所以我們穿溫暖的外套。

example_1_en: My favorite season of the year is cool autumn.
example_1_zh_tw: 我一年中最喜歡的季節是涼爽的秋天。
example_2_en: Winter is a cold season, but Christmas is warm.
example_2_zh_tw: 冬天是一個寒冷的季節，但耶誕節卻很溫暖。

example_1_en: Monday is the first school day of the week.
example_1_zh_tw: 星期一是這一週的第一個上學日。
example_2_en: We sing the school song together on Monday morning.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在星期一早上一起唱校歌。

example_1_en: We have a music class every Tuesday afternoon.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們每個星期二下午有一節音樂課。
example_2_en: We have a PE lesson and play soccer on Tuesday.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在星期二有一堂體育課並踢足球。

example_1_en: Wednesday afternoon is our sports and club time.
example_1_zh_tw: 星期三下午是我們的運動和社團時間。
example_2_en: Our school has a half day of classes on Wednesday.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們學校星期三只上半天課。

example_1_en: We will visit the science museum next Thursday morning.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們下星期四早上將造訪自然科學博物館。
example_2_en: I borrow new storybooks from the library on Thursday.
example_2_zh_tw: 我星期四在圖書館借新的故事書。

example_1_en: Friday is the last school day before the weekend.
example_1_zh_tw: 星期五是週末前的最後一個上學日。
example_2_en: Friday is my favorite day because the weekend is near.
example_2_zh_tw: 星期五是我最喜歡的一天，因為週末快到了。

example_1_en: I like to go hiking with my family on Saturday.
example_1_zh_tw: 我星期六喜歡和家人一起去健行。
example_2_en: I love to eat hot pancakes on Saturday morning.
example_2_zh_tw: 我喜歡在星期六早上吃熱鬆餅。

example_1_en: Sunday is a holiday, and we can rest at home.
example_1_zh_tw: 星期天是假日，我們可以留在家裡休息。
example_2_en: We go hiking on the mountain with family on Sunday.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們星期日和家人一起去山上健行。

example_1_en: There are seven days in a single week.
example_1_zh_tw: 單單一週內就有七天。
example_2_en: There are seven days in a week.
example_2_zh_tw: 一星期有七天。

example_1_en: January is the very first month of the year.
example_1_zh_tw: 一月是一年當中的第一個月份。
example_2_en: January first is the beginning of a new year.
example_2_zh_tw: 一月一日是一年的開始。

example_1_en: February usually has twenty-eight days in a year.
example_1_zh_tw: 二月份在一年中通常只有二十八天。
example_2_en: February is the second and shortest month of the year.
example_2_zh_tw: 二月是一年中第二個也是最短的月份。

example_1_en: The weather starts to turn warm in March here.
example_1_zh_tw: 這裡的天氣在三月份開始轉暖。
example_2_en: Spring usually starts to arrive in March.
example_2_zh_tw: 春天通常在三月份開始到來。

example_1_en: April showers bring beautiful flowers in spring.
example_1_zh_tw: 四月的雨水在春天帶來了美麗的花朵。
example_2_en: My cousin has a birthday party in April.
example_2_zh_tw: 我表弟/表妹在四月舉辦生日派對。

example_1_en: Mother's Day is celebrated on the second Sunday of May.
example_1_zh_tw: 母親節在五月的第二個星期日慶祝。
example_2_en: May I borrow your green marker for my painting?
example_2_zh_tw: 我畫畫可以借你的綠色白板筆嗎？

example_1_en: Summer vacation usually begins in the late June.
example_1_zh_tw: 暑假通常在六月下旬開始。
example_2_en: School ends in June, and summer vacation starts.
example_2_zh_tw: 學校在六月結束，暑假開始。

example_1_en: July is a very hot month of the summer holiday.
example_1_zh_tw: 七月是暑假中一個非常炎熱的月份。
example_2_en: It is hot in July, and we go swimming.
example_2_zh_tw: 七月天氣很熱，我們去游泳。

example_1_en: Father's Day in Taiwan is on the eighth of August.
example_1_zh_tw: 台灣的父親節是在八月八日。
example_2_en: August is the last month of our summer vacation.
example_2_zh_tw: 八月是我們暑假的最後一個月。

example_1_en: Students go back to school in September in Taiwan.
example_1_zh_tw: 台灣的學生在九月份返校上課。
example_2_en: We go back to school in September to meet our friends.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在九月回學校和朋友見面。

example_1_en: Halloween is celebrated on the last day of October.
example_1_zh_tw: 萬聖節在十月的最後一天慶祝。
example_2_en: Halloween is celebrated on the last day of October.
example_2_zh_tw: 萬聖節在十月的最後一天慶祝。

example_1_en: The weather turns cool and pleasant in November.
example_1_zh_tw: 天氣在十一月份變得涼爽宜人。
example_2_en: The weather gets cool in November in Taiwan.
example_2_zh_tw: 台灣在十一月時天氣變涼。

example_1_en: Christmas is celebrated on the twenty-fifth of December.
example_1_zh_tw: 聖誕節在十二月二十五日慶祝。
example_2_en: We decorate the classroom for Christmas in December.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在十二月裝飾教室準備過耶誕節。

example_1_en: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
example_1_zh_tw: 我想學習如何騎腳踏車。
example_2_en: My sister likes to ride her kick scooter in the park.
example_2_zh_tw: 我妹妹喜歡在公園裡騎她的滑板車。

example_1_en: Many birds fly to warm places in winter.
example_1_zh_tw: 許多鳥在冬天飛往溫暖的地方。
example_2_en: A big airplane can fly high above the white clouds.
example_2_zh_tw: 大飛機可以在白雲高空飛行。

example_1_en: My mother drives a blue car to work daily.
example_1_zh_tw: 我媽媽每天開著藍色車子去上班。
example_2_en: Please drive slowly when you pass the school gate.
example_2_zh_tw: 路過校門口時請減速慢行/慢速駕駛。

example_1_en: Please turn right when you see the post office.
example_1_zh_tw: 當你看到郵局時請右轉。
example_2_en: It is your turn to answer the English question now.
example_2_zh_tw: 現在輪到你回答英文問題了。

example_1_en: My father parked the red car near our house.
example_1_zh_tw: 我爸爸把紅色的車子停在我們家附近。
example_2_en: My parents bought a new green car last month.
example_2_zh_tw: 我父母上個月買了一輛綠色的新車。

example_1_en: We take the school bus to school every morning.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們每天早上搭校車去上學。
example_2_en: We must stand in line to get on the school bus.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們必須排隊搭乘校車。

example_1_en: The students are waiting patiently at the bus stop.
example_1_zh_tw: 學生們正在公車站耐心等待。
example_2_en: The bus stop is just a few steps away from our house.
example_2_zh_tw: 公車站離我們家只有幾步之遙。

example_1_en: We took a taxi because we were very late.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們搭了計程車，因為我們遲到了。
example_2_en: The yellow taxi stopped in front of the train station.
example_2_zh_tw: 黃色的計程車停在火車站前。

example_1_en: The airplane landed safely at the Taoyuan airport.
example_1_zh_tw: 飛機安全降落在桃園機場。
example_2_en: We went to the airport to welcome our grandfather.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們去機場迎接我們的爺爺。

example_1_en: A large cargo ship is sailing across the ocean.
example_1_zh_tw: 一艘大型貨輪正在橫渡大洋。
example_2_en: A giant cruise ship is resting in the quiet harbor.
example_2_zh_tw: 一艘巨型郵輪停泊在安靜的港口。

example_1_en: We rode a small wooden boat on the lake.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們在湖上划了一艘木製小船。
example_2_en: My grandpa owns a small fishing boat on the river.
example_2_zh_tw: 我爺爺在河上有一艘捕魚小船。

example_1_en: The train arrived at the station on time.
example_1_zh_tw: 火車準時抵達了車站。
example_2_en: We met our friends at the bus station this morning.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們今天早上在公車站和朋友見面。

example_1_en: Riding a motorcycle in Taiwan is very common.
example_1_zh_tw: 在台灣騎機車是非常普遍的。
example_2_en: My father wears a heavy helmet to ride his motorcycle.
example_2_zh_tw: 我爸爸戴著厚重的安全帽騎機車。

example_1_en: The Taipei MRT is very clean and convenient.
example_1_zh_tw: 台北捷運非常乾淨且方便。
example_2_en: Taking the MRT is a safe way to travel around the city.
example_2_zh_tw: 搭乘捷運是在城市裡旅遊的安全方式。

example_1_en: She rides a light scooter to the local market.
example_1_zh_tw: 她騎著輕型機車去當地的市場。
example_2_en: The child rides a pink kick scooter in the park.
example_2_zh_tw: 那個孩子在公園裡玩粉紅色滑板車。

example_1_en: Cheetahs can run very fast in the wild grass.
example_1_zh_tw: 獵豹可以在野生草叢中跑得很快。
example_2_en: If you walk fast, you can catch up with the group.
example_2_zh_tw: 如果你走得快，你就能趕上隊伍。

example_1_en: The slow turtle finally finished the long race.
example_1_zh_tw: 慢吞吞的烏龜終於完成了這場長途比賽。
example_2_en: The slow train stops at every station along the way.
example_2_zh_tw: 這慢車沿途在每個車站都停靠。

example_1_en: A large blue truck is carrying heavy boxes.
example_1_zh_tw: 一輛藍色大卡車正載運著重重的箱子。
example_2_en: The farmer filled the truck with sweet pumpkins.
example_2_zh_tw: 農夫在卡車上裝滿了甜南瓜。

example_1_en: What is the weather like in New York today?
example_1_zh_tw: 今天紐約的天氣怎麼樣？
example_2_en: The warm weather is perfect for playing soccer outdoors.
example_2_zh_tw: 溫暖的天氣非常適合在戶外踢足球。

example_1_en: The sky is clear and full of bright stars.
example_1_zh_tw: 天空非常清朗，而且佈滿了明亮的星星。
example_2_en: The blue sky has no clouds at all this morning.
example_2_zh_tw: 今天早上蔚藍的天空一點雲也沒有。

example_1_en: The sun is shining brightly in the sky today.
example_1_zh_tw: 今天太陽在天空中明亮地照耀著。
example_2_en: The warm sun keeps us comfortable during winter.
example_2_zh_tw: 溫暖的太陽讓我們在冬天感到舒服。

example_1_en: The little star is twinkling in the dark sky.
example_1_zh_tw: 小星星在漆黑的天空中閃爍。
example_2_en: She got a shiny gold star on her homework book.
example_2_zh_tw: 她的作業本上得到了一個閃亮的金星獎章。

example_1_en: The strong wind blew away my favorite paper hat.
example_1_zh_tw: 強風吹走了我最愛的紙帽子。
example_2_en: The cold wind started to blow in the late afternoon.
example_2_zh_tw: 傍晚時分，冷風開始吹了起來。

example_1_en: It is very windy today, so let us fly kites.
example_1_zh_tw: 今天風很大，我們去放風箏吧。
example_2_en: Hold your hat on a windy day so it doesn't fly away.
example_2_zh_tw: 在有風的日子拉好帽子，以免它被吹走。

example_1_en: Schools were closed yesterday because of the strong typhoon.
example_1_zh_tw: 學校昨天因為強烈颱風停課。
example_2_en: We stayed safe inside our house during the typhoon.
example_2_zh_tw: 颱風期間我們安全地待在屋子裡。

example_1_en: I love the fresh smell of grass after rain.
example_1_zh_tw: 我喜歡雨後草地清新的味道。
example_2_en: The grass needs rain to grow green and fresh.
example_2_zh_tw: 草地需要雨水來生長得又綠又鮮嫩。

example_1_en: A colorful rainbow appeared in the sky after rain.
example_1_zh_tw: 雨後天空出現了一道色彩繽紛的彩虹。
example_2_en: Let's draw a beautiful seven-color rainbow on the card.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們在卡片上畫一道美麗的七彩彩虹吧。

example_1_en: The white snow covered the mountains like a blanket.
example_1_zh_tw: 白雪像毯子一樣覆蓋了山脈。
example_2_en: It is fun to make a round snowman in the snow.
example_2_zh_tw: 在雪中做一個圓圓的雪人很有趣。

example_1_en: We wore warm gloves on that cold snowy day.
example_1_zh_tw: 我們在那個寒冷的下雪天戴了溫暖的手套。
example_2_en: The mountains turned white on a cold snowy morning.
example_2_zh_tw: 在一個寒冷下雪的早上，山脈變白了。

example_1_en: My shoes got completely wet in the heavy rain.
example_1_zh_tw: 我的鞋子在大雨中完全濕透了。
example_2_en: Use a towel to wipe your wet hands before lunch.
example_2_zh_tw: 午餐前用毛巾擦乾你濕漉漉的手。

example_1_en: It is cloudy today, so the sun is hidden.
example_1_zh_tw: 今天是陰天，所以太陽躲起來了。
example_2_en: We can go for a walk since it is cloudy and cool.
example_2_zh_tw: 因為天氣多雲涼爽，我們可以出去散步。

example_1_en: Drink plenty of water on hot summer days.
example_1_zh_tw: 在炎熱的夏天要喝充足的水。
example_2_en: This hot noodle soup tastes spicy and delicious.
example_2_zh_tw: 這碗熱麵湯嚐起來香辣美味。

example_1_en: The spring weather is very warm and pleasant here.
example_1_zh_tw: 這裡春天的天氣非常溫暖且宜人。
example_2_en: The mother bird keeps her baby chicks warm in the nest.
example_2_zh_tw: 母鳥在鳥巢裡為牠的小雞保暖。

example_1_en: The autumn breeze is very cool and refreshing.
example_1_zh_tw: 秋天的微風非常涼爽而且提神。
example_2_en: His new bicycle looks really cool and fast.
example_2_zh_tw: 他的新自行車看起來真的很酷、很快。

example_1_en: I saw a small squirrel eating a nut yesterday.
example_1_zh_tw: 我昨天看到一隻小松鼠在吃堅果。
example_2_en: I have a friendly puppy that loves to chase balls.
example_2_zh_tw: 我有一隻很喜歡追球的友善小狗。

example_1_en: She brought an orange and an apple for lunch.
example_1_zh_tw: 她帶了一個橘子和一個蘋果當午餐。
example_2_en: She shared an orange with her brother after lunch.
example_2_zh_tw: 她午餐後和她哥哥分享了一顆柳橙。

example_1_en: He practices speaking English every single day.
example_1_zh_tw: 他每一天都練習說英文。
example_2_en: We should drink water every day to keep healthy.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們應該每天喝水來保持健康。

example_1_en: The dog in the garden belongs to our neighbor.
example_1_zh_tw: 花園裡的那隻狗是我們鄰居的。
example_2_en: The sky looks very clear and bright tonight.
example_2_zh_tw: 今天晚上的天空看起來非常清朗且明亮。

example_1_en: This storybook is very interesting and has nice pictures.
example_1_zh_tw: 這本故事書非常有趣，而且有漂亮的圖片。
example_2_en: This English book belongs to the school library.
example_2_zh_tw: 這本英文書屬於學校圖書館。

example_1_en: That tall tree in the park is a banyan.
example_1_zh_tw: 公園裡那棵高大的樹是一棵榕樹。

example_1_zh_tw: 守門員成功接住了足球。
example_2_en: The goalie caught the soccer ball with a quick dive.
example_2_zh_tw: 守門員一個快速飛身接住了足球。

example_1_en: Many birds have flown to warm places in winter.
example_1_zh_tw: 許多鳥在冬天已經飛往溫暖的地方。
example_2_en: The wild geese have already flown to warm areas.
example_2_zh_tw: 大雁們已經飛往溫暖的地區。

example_1_en: He felt very happy when he won the game.
example_1_zh_tw: 當他贏了比賽時感到非常高興。
example_2_en: I felt very warm after drinking a cup of hot milk.
example_2_zh_tw: 喝了一杯熱牛奶後我感覺非常溫暖。

zh_tw: 找到(過去式/過去分詞)/建立
example_1_en: She found her lost key under the kitchen table.
example_1_zh_tw: 她在廚房桌子底下找到了她遺失的鑰匙。
example_2_en: She found a beautiful shell in the sand yesterday.
example_2_zh_tw: 她昨天在沙灘上找到了一個美麗的貝殼。

zh_tw: 生長/成長(過去分詞)/成年的
example_1_en: The little tree has grown tall in the garden.
example_1_zh_tw: 那棵小樹在花園裡已經長高了。
example_2_en: The small seeds have grown into beautiful yellow flowers.
example_2_zh_tw: 小種子已經長成了美麗的黃花。

example_1_en: The small puppy grew into a big strong dog.
example_1_zh_tw: 小狗長大成了一隻強壯的大狗。
example_2_en: The baby puppy grew very fast in just three months.
example_2_zh_tw: 幼犬寶寶在短短三個月內就長得非常快。

example_1_en: I heard someone knocking on the door yesterday.
example_1_zh_tw: 我昨天聽到有人在敲門。
example_2_en: We heard a beautiful bird singing in the garden.
example_2_zh_tw: 我們聽到一隻美麗的鳥在花園裡唱歌。

example_1_en: He has been known as a kind doctor here.
example_1_zh_tw: 他一直以來在這裡被知曉是一位親切的醫生。
example_2_en: This school is well known for its physical education club.
example_2_zh_tw: 這所學校以其體育社團而聞名。

example_1_en: English is spoken by many people in the world.
example_1_zh_tw: 英語被世界上許多人所說。
example_2_en: The spoken words of gratitude made mother very happy.
example_2_zh_tw: 口頭說出的感激之言讓媽媽非常高興。

example_1_en: The students stood up when the teacher walked in.
example_1_zh_tw: 當老師走進來時，學生們站了起來。
example_2_en: He stood by the school gate to welcome the students.
example_2_zh_tw: 他站在校門口迎接學生。

example_1_en: I thought the English test was very easy.
example_1_zh_tw: 我本來以為英文測驗很簡單。
example_2_en: I thought about your wonderful idea all afternoon.
example_2_zh_tw: 我整個下午都在思考你那極棒的主意。

example_1_en: She has written many interesting stories for kids.
example_1_zh_tw: 她已經為孩子們寫了許多有趣的故事。
example_2_en: All the new English words are written on the blackboard.
example_2_zh_tw: 所有的新英文單字都寫在黑板上。
